1. `src/retrieval/ranker.js` is the core: `rank()` takes the natural-language query, detects intent, tokenizes it, and combines per-signal scores using `DEFAULT_WEIGHTS` plus optional learned, graph, and centrality boosts.
2. `src/retrieval/tokenizer.js` turns the raw query into lower-case tokens (splitting camelCase/snake_case, dropping stop words), which is the first step before any weighting.
3. `src/retrieval/bm25.js` supplies the BM25 term-weighting signal that the ranker blends with its other signals.
4. `src/retrieval/mined-expansions.js` adds expanded query terms, so the weighted signals can match files that don't share the exact words in the question.
5. `src/retrieval/body-words.js` builds the per-file rare-word signal (`retrieval.bodyWords`) that `rank()` takes as an input.
